items.docs:
Provides the high frequency data of an ECG recording in micro-volt (μV).

**Duration:**

 - BPM Core: 20 seconds.
 - Move ECG: 30 seconds.
 - ScanWatch: 30 seconds.

**Sampling frequency:**

 - BPM Core: 500 Hz.
 - Move ECG: 300 Hz.
 - ScanWatch: 300 Hz.

params.description: When a first call returns ```more:true``` and ```offset:XX```, set value ```XX``` in this parameter to retrieve next available rows.

items.docs:
Returns a list of ECG records and Afib classification for a given period of time.
To get the full ECG signal, use the [Heart v2 - Get](#operation/heartv2-get) service.

If the ECG recordings have been taken with BPM Core, systole and diastole measurements will also be returned.
